column55: WOW! What an amazing NEW BUILD with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 car garage, fully fenced backyard and an incredible kitchen. Fall in love with the gorgeous landscaping in your front yard and a front porch with exterior lighting. As soon as you go inside immediately cherish the openness and TILED great room with your living room to your right, kitchen in the middle including GRANITE COUNTERTOPS, real wood cabinets, WALK-IN PANTRY with wire shelving racks and STAINLESS STEEL APPLIANCES. As you go farther inside, to your left you can find the TILED dining room with BLINDS and a new light fixture. Following the TILE FLOOR into the hallway on the right appreciate your washer and dryer in a closet, tucked away until it’s laundry day. As you keep going through the hallway you can find the CARPETED master bedroom with a WALK IN CLOSET, blinds and on the side is your TILED master bathroom with DUAL SINKS, granite countertops, real wood cabinets, and a stand up shower. As you exit the master bedroom straight ahead you can find the other TILED bathroom including granite countertops, real wood cabinets, and a tub with shower. Adjacent to the bathroom you can find two CARPETED bedrooms with blinds, and two closet doors. Some additional features include NO HOA, windows are double insulated, hybrid hot water heater, and a security system. If you like to be outdoors you’re in luck you can find multiple parks nearby, McKay Bay, Hillsborough Bay, Lowry Park, Tampa Riverwalk, and so much more! Even if being outside isn’t for you there’s lots to do indoors close by including The Florida Aquarium, several museums, International mall and other malls, bowling and tons more! Also some roads close by for quick commute include the Suncoast, US-41, I-4, and the Selmon Expressway.
